newsitem.title: POLAND: AUSTRALIAN BREWPOLE TO INVEST IN POLISH BREWER.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN BREWPOLE TO INVEST IN POLISH BREWER.

text.p: Australian company Brewpole BV plans to invest $27 million within the 12 months to modernise its fully owned Polish subsidiary, brewer Hevelius Brewing Co., Brewpole said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said Poland's Bank Handlowy will be give the investment credit and that Brewpole will fully guarantee it.
Brewpole, the full owner of Hevelius since October 1995, also has a controling stake in Poland's largest brewery, Elbrewery Company Ltd.
Brewpole is owned by a group of Australian investors and Dutch brewer Royal Grolsch NV, which has a 25 percent stake in the firm.
